requisitoLingua.citazione: Language of Instruction: mostly German. For access to the complete course lists, German B2. Non-German speaking students must prove their English language proficiency by submitting an official language certificate, proving B2-English.

scadenzeOspitante.citazione: Nomination Deadlines: 15. April (WS), 31. October (SoSe). Application Deadlines: 15. May (WS), 15. November (SoSe).

notaDisponibilita.citazione: Elementary Teacher Education: German-speakers only, minimum B2 (as of 2025/26) Primary Teacher Education: non-German speakers welcome. Secondary Teacher Education: non-German speakers welcome.

linkCatalogo.citazione: At least 70% of your course load must be in a field of study that figures in the exchange agreement.
